remarks: Large 820 sq ft, charming and convenient first floor unit. It features hardwood floors, high ceilings, archways, moldings, large entry foyer, pretty views of courtyard and gazebo. The complex has beautiful grounds, sidewalks, benches, barbecue area and three parking lots. Just across the street, there is grocery shopping, Starbucks, lots of stores and a gym. It is an easy walk to downtown Stamford, Scalzi Park and a scenic path along the river. Woodside Green is only 1 mile from the train station. Cooking gas, city water, city sewer and hot water are included in HOAs. Other features are stainless steal appliances, new energy efficient windows, new dishwasher, new blinds. Currently occupied by tenant. Owner/Agent.
